summary: Pennington County, SD tower built spring 1939 in the Black Hills National Forest; removed about 1961, with only concrete foundations left by 2022.

facts.status_note: Tower removed about 1961; by 2022 only the concrete foundations for the tower and stairs remained

events.note: Built spring 1939 per the register; firelookout.com gives a 30-foot steel tower with L-4 cab
Register: originally staffed by William Grover, who was to man the tower for the fire season
Lookout phoned in white smoke north of the cement plant; a grass burn near the railroad tracks, controlled by a group of men
Galen and Effie McCain listed for 1949, 1953 and 1955
Man-caused fire near Pactola Reservoir burned two acres; spotted from the lookout
Register gives removal as circa 1961; appropriations for the tower ended in 1961
March 1961 land order lists the Boulder Hill lookout (Rapid City Journal item)
Last staffing year on the firelookout.com list
By 2022 only the concrete foundations for the tower and its stairs remained (register)

notes_for_editor: Elevation conflicts: register 5,175 ft (the record's value), firelookout.com 5,335 ft, 1939 newspaper 5,400 ft. Removal: register says appropriations ended and removal circa 1961; firelookout.com lists a lookout through 1963. Newspaper quotes are as transcribed on Forest Lookouts; the originals were not read. Caption on the register photo matches the foundations. A geocache listing and a summit-blog reference were not used (the geocache page returned no text). No new photos.
